request: Please find me data regarding first-of-class ship cost overruns

reply.reply: The reviewed CRS reports provide useful lead-ship cost data, but do not verify a first-of-class overrun percentage. The clearest amount is the Ford-class lead ship CVN-78’s final procurement cost: $13,316.5 million in then-year dollars (CRS RS20643, PDF p. 7). For comparison, FY2026 budget material estimates LPD-17 Flight II at $2,129.9 million per ship (CRS R43543, PDF p. 8), while FFG-62 frigates were budgeted at roughly $1.2–$1.3 billion each (CRS R44972, PDF p. 10). These latter figures are estimates, not realized overruns. The brief includes the supporting quotes and evidence: output/briefs/case-20261025-145933-f9da.html.
reply.reasoning: The verified evidence supplies final or estimated ship costs, but no sufficiently verifiable first-of-class overrun percentage. Labeling the estimates as overruns would be misleading.
